name: flightwake-mod
description: flightwake's Claude Code layer: STATE in the system prompt, a quiet status band, a session flight log, trap tripwires, tokens and API-equivalent cost, a session fleet (who is blocked, working, idle or resumable across sessions), an on-request side panel, and an opt-in role guard. Reads .flightwake/, git, this session's transcript and ~/.flightwake/sessions; its only writes are this session's state file in ~/.flightwake/sessions, outside the repo, and the panel's open/closed preference in its own plugin store. Never writes your records.

stateInject.title: Load STATE at session start
stateInject.description: Add .flightwake/STATE.md (as it stood when the session started) to the system prompt. /fw-coldstart still checks the lag and reads the latest record.

band.title: Status band
band.description: A row above the prompt with health, STATE lag, context use and the next command; silent while all is well. One toast when context runs hot.

recorder.title: Session flight log
recorder.description: Note files changed, recognised test commands with their results, and commits in this session; /fw-log prints them for fw-record. Never writes a record.

tripwire.title: Trap tripwires
tripwire.description: When a file or command matches an active TRAPS entry's paths/commands fields, show that entry to the agent once per session. Never blocks.

roleGuard.title: Role guard
roleGuard.description: Turn the mechanically checkable Never rules of this folder's Claude seat role into blocks on writes and commands. /fw-role-release lifts it for the session. Off by default.

spend.title: Tokens and cost
spend.description: Tokens used this session (summed from the transcript) and the API-equivalent cost from Claude Code's own ledger, on the band and in /fw-mod; /fw-cost prints the breakdown. Never a bill on a subscription.

fleet.title: Session fleet
fleet.description: Report this session's state (working / blocked / idle / ended) to ~/.flightwake/sessions/<id>.json for /fw-fleet, the bottom gauge and `npx flightwake fleet`. Never prompt or command text.

panel.title: Side panel
panel.description: /fw-panel opens a pane beside the transcript with STATE, this session's flight log and cost, and the other sessions; once opened it reopens in later sessions until you close it. Never opens unless you ask.
